findings.title: Camera Capture Capability Detected
findings.description: Application requests camera permission and references camera capture APIs.
findings.remediation_relevance: Verify camera hardware access is necessary and accompanied by runtime prompts.
limitations: Static analysis cannot prove runtime camera usage.

findings.title: Device Identifier Access References Detected
findings.description: Static code references found for device identifiers: TelephonyManager.getDeviceId, TelephonyManager.getImei, TelephonyManager.getSubscriberId, Settings.Secure.ANDROID_ID, Build.SERIAL.
findings.remediation_relevance: Assess compliance with modern Android platform guidelines; prefer resettable identifiers.
limitations: Static method reference does not establish that the identifier is sent across the network.

findings.title: Camera Hardware & Capture APIs
findings.description: Static references to Camera, Camera2, or CameraX APIs detected in bytecode.
findings.remediation_relevance: Ensure camera hardware access is necessary and accompanied by runtime consent prompts.
limitations: Static observation of API or component reference does not guarantee runtime execution or data exfiltration.

findings.title: Clipboard Access APIs
findings.description: Static references to ClipboardManager clip access methods detected.
findings.remediation_relevance: Verify whether clipboard reads access user data unexpectedly.
limitations: Static observation of API or component reference does not guarantee runtime execution or data exfiltration.

findings.title: Location Framework API Invocations
findings.description: Static references to Android LocationManager or Google Play Services location providers detected in bytecode.
findings.remediation_relevance: Informational; examine whether precise or coarse location access is required for core functionality.
limitations: Static observation of API or component reference does not guarantee runtime execution or data exfiltration.

findings.title: Reflection on Internal or Sensitive Classes
findings.description: Static references to reflection APIs combined with internal framework class names detected.
findings.remediation_relevance: Reflection may access hidden or non-SDK interfaces; ensure platform compatibility and policy compliance.
limitations: Static observation of API or component reference does not guarantee runtime execution or data exfiltration.

findings.title: Background Job Scheduling & Alarm APIs
findings.description: Static references to WorkManager, JobScheduler, or AlarmManager background execution detected.
findings.remediation_relevance: Evaluate whether background tasks perform unauthorized periodic synchronization or data transmission.
limitations: Static observation of API or component reference does not guarantee runtime execution or data exfiltration.

findings.title: Embedded WebView & Web Interface APIs
findings.description: Static references to Android WebView configuration and web execution interfaces detected.
findings.remediation_relevance: Review WebView security settings (e.g. JavaScript execution and native interface bridges).
limitations: Static observation of API or component reference does not guarantee runtime execution or data exfiltration.

findings.title: Boot & Package Replacement Receivers
findings.description: Manifest declarations for broadcast receivers listening to device boot or package replacement events.
findings.remediation_relevance: Review background startup persistence at device boot.
limitations: Static observation of API or component reference does not guarantee runtime execution or data exfiltration.

findings.title: Accessibility Service Declaration & APIs
findings.description: Declaration or implementation of an Android AccessibilityService detected.
findings.remediation_relevance: Accessibility services have broad device observation capabilities; verify legitimate assistive use.
limitations: Static observation of API or component reference does not guarantee runtime execution or data exfiltration.

findings.title: Hardware & Device Identifier Access
findings.description: Static references to persistent device identifiers (IMEI, MEID, SIM serial, or ANDROID_ID) detected.
findings.remediation_relevance: Assess compliance with modern Android platform privacy guidelines (prefer resettable advertising IDs or app-scoped UUIDs over hardware identifiers).
limitations: Static observation of API or component reference does not guarantee runtime execution or data exfiltration.

findings.title: Dynamic Code Loading Facilities
findings.description: Static references to DexClassLoader, PathClassLoader, or InMemoryDexClassLoader detected.
findings.remediation_relevance: Dynamic loading allows runtime code execution bypassing static inspection; verify source and integrity.
limitations: Static observation of API or component reference does not guarantee runtime execution or data exfiltration.

findings.title: Clipboard Access Capability Detected
findings.remediation_relevance: Verify clipboard reads access user data only upon direct user paste interaction.
limitations: Static reference does not prove unprompted clipboard reading.

findings.title: Accessibility Service Capability Detected
findings.description: Application defines or references an Android AccessibilityService.
findings.remediation_relevance: Accessibility services require explicit user opt-in in Android system settings.
limitations: Requires explicit user opt-in in Android system settings.

findings.title: Location Capability Detected

findings.remediation_relevance: Ensure location access is transparent and justified by application features.
limitations: Static analysis cannot establish runtime location collection.
